content:
MikroTik KNOT Gateway HL9 is an IP66-rated outdoor IoT gateway that combines 915 MHz Wi-Fi HaLow (802.11ah), Bluetooth 5.1, Wi-Fi 6, LTE Cat 1 bis, Gigabit Ethernet, and GNSS. The gateway supports asset tracking, remote sensor monitoring, industrial IoT, and agricultural applications. Built around a dual-core Qualcomm IPQ-5010 ARM64 processor, it features 256MB RAM and 128MB NAND flash. It relies on a Morse Micro MM6108 Wi-Fi HaLow SoC for sub-GHz connectivity, with Gigabit Ethernet, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi 6, and LTE Cat 1 bis cellular for backhaul. MikroTik KNOT Gateway HL9 specifications: SoC – Qualcomm IPQ-5010 dual-core 64-bit Arm processor @ 800 MHz Memory – 256MB RAM Storage – 128MB NAND flash Connectivity Ethernet – Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 port with 802.3af/at PoE-in support Wi-Fi HaLow – 915 MHz IEEE 802.11ah via Morse Micro MM6108 SoC Wi-Fi – 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi 6 (802.11b/g/n/ax), 1×1, up to 287 Mbps, 3.9 dBi integrated antenna [...]
